results.escalation_summary: Orders 49, 50 and 51 were created at tick 4. Each has a captured payment (payment ids 49-51). They are still in status 'created'. The queue table has no entry for any of them: queue ids 46-48 map to orders 46-48, and id 49 maps to order 52. There are no shipments for them either, so the failure happened between payment capture and enqueue. Everything else is healthy. Orders before and after this batch were enqueued and shipped normally. Metrics for payment errors and timeouts, queue depth, dropped messages and dead letters are all flat at 0 or normal. Config history has only the initial bootstrap values, with no recent change. There are no WARN or ERROR logs, and the dead_letter table is empty. Two ticks of waiting did not change anything. retry_stuck_payments only handles orders with no payment record, and these orders have one, so it would not apply and could risk a double charge. replay_dead_letter has nothing to replay. I have no tool that enqueues an order directly, so I took no action.
